name: 98284 · Sedro Woolley, WA
findings: ZIP 98284 (Sedro Woolley) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98284 (Sedro Woolley) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98284 (Sedro Woolley) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).
